multiplicity.frontier_status: all non-primary catalog combinations are exploratory/descriptive; raw Pareto or best-cell rank is never Edge evidence
multiplicity.negative_rule: negative/no-promotion results report full frontier and may use proportionate descriptive evidence
multiplicity.positive_inference: 20,000 paired stationary-block bootstrap max-T family-wise adjusted lower bounds at alpha=0.05; test all candidate-minus-control lifts within each frozen family
multiplicity.winner_rule: screen all cells, but no ladder advancement unless the preregistered H1 or a family-wise adjusted candidate passes strict matched PI review

primary_hypothesis.comparison: absolute pre-tax ¥100k path plus matched lift versus B170 BEST_FULL/FULL on exact common support and actual funding convention
primary_hypothesis.decision: a positive claim requires paired sequential lower bound >0, all primary support/capital controls, and later independent held-out/forward validation

sequential_inference.iid_diagnostic: IID issue bootstrap is ROI-only diagnostic and must not support bankroll, drawdown, recovery, dynamic-weight or compounded-growth claims
sequential_inference.moving_block_sensitivity: paired moving block bootstrap, block lengths 6, 12 and 20 chronological issues; full state replay
sequential_inference.path_bootstrap: paired stationary block bootstrap, 20,000 replicates, expected block length 12 issues, seed 192001, each candidate/control shares exact resampled blocks and replays the complete state machine
sequential_inference.primary_estimand: original strict chronological walk-forward replay; recompute weights, funding, cash, equity, drawdown and all state inside every replay
